claim: Naming a mechanism from the surface that moves gets 471 of 1,179 campaign mechanisms wrong. 122 sectors whose floor moves change what fits through a portal, 102 whose ceiling moves change nothing; of 88 auto-rotating sectors (campaign, curated and converted maps) 6 are doors. kSectorZMotion is read 671 times as changing what fits through and 186 as carrying a body between levels, and 972 of 1,236 are moved by something else. 662 sliding or turning sectors cannot be named from z at all.
evidence: 2,027 moving sectors over 43 campaign maps, counted by bloodmap.effects, 2026-08-31 and 2026-11-19.
use: Name from two spatial questions (does the motion change whether a body fits, asked both ways; does it carry a body between two standing levels), and let the reading decline.
